<style>
.rcg-house-page{--rcg-ink:#2e2723;--rcg-muted:#6a5d52;--rcg-paper:#fffaf2;--rcg-line:#e8d7bd;--rcg-accent:#b4532a;--rcg-bg:#fffaf2;--rcg-stage:#f6e3cf;color:var(--rcg-ink);max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto 3rem;line-height:1.5}
.rcg-house-page *{box-sizing:border-box}.rcg-house-page [hidden]{display:none!important}
/* Buttons match the page: warm paper, softly rounded corners, terracotta when active. */
.bk-model button,.bk-model select,.bk-model input{font:inherit}.bk-model button,.bk-model select{color:var(--rcg-ink);border:1px solid var(--rcg-line);background:var(--rcg-paper);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 13px;cursor:pointer;min-height:40px}.bk-model button:hover{background:#f6e7d3}.bk-model button:focus-visible,.bk-model select:focus-visible,.bk-model input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rcg-accent);outline-offset:2px}.bk-model button:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait}
.rcg-house-page .house-tour{background:var(--rcg-accent);color:#fffaf2;border-color:var(--rcg-accent)}.rcg-house-page .house-tour:hover{background:#93401d}
.house-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:0 0 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rcg-line)}.house-eyebrow{font-size:.85rem!important;color:var(--rcg-accent);margin:0 0 4px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em}.house-header h2{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2rem);font-weight:400;color:var(--rcg-ink);margin:0}.house-subtitle{font-size:.95rem;margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--rcg-muted)}
.house-tools{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rcg-line)}.house-modes{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}.house-modes button{font-size:.95rem;padding:6px 11px;min-height:36px}.house-modes button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--rcg-accent);color:#fffaf2;border-color:var(--rcg-accent)}.house-filters{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.95rem}.house-filters label{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin:0}.house-filters select{font-size:.95rem;padding:6px 8px;min-height:36px}.house-filters input{accent-color:var(--rcg-accent);width:15px;height:15px}
.house-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 285px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rcg-line)}.house-stage{position:relative;min-width:0;height:590px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--rcg-stage);border:1px solid var(--rcg-line);border-radius:8px;margin:14px 0}.house-canvas{width:100%;height:100%}.house-canvas canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none}.house-canvas>img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}.house-info{padding:14px 0}.house-tour{width:100%;font-size:.95rem!important}.house-tour-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:5px}.house-tour-nav button{font-size:.95rem;padding:6px 10px}.house-tour-position{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--rcg-muted);white-space:nowrap}.house-reference-grid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.house-reference-grid button{width:calc(50% - img{width:100%;height:78px;object-fit:cover;display:block}.house-reference-grid span{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;color:#fff;background:#000000a8;font-size:.7rem;padding:1px p{margin:10px 0}.house-notes button{font-size:.95rem;padding:6px solid #e8d7bd;border-radius:5px;padding:5px 9px;margin:0;pointer-events:none;max-width:355px}.house-view-badge{position:absolute;left:15px;top:15px;background:#fffaf2;color:#b4532a;font-size:.85rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:3px 9px;border:1px solid #e8d7bd;border-radius:5px}.house-loading{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--rcg-ink);background:var(--rcg-stage);font-size:.95rem;padding:24px;text-align:center}.house-loading.house-fallback{inset:auto 15px 55px;background:#fffaf2e6;border:1px solid #e8d7bd;border-radius:6px;font-size:.95rem}.house-labels{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}.house-room-label{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:auto;font-size:.7rem!important;padding:3px 7px!important;min-height:26px!important;border-radius:5px!important;border-color:#e8d7bd!important;color:#2e2723!important;background:#fffaf2f0!important;max-width:160px}.house-room-label:hover{background:#f6e7d3!important}.house-room-label.is-selected{border-color:#b4532a!important;color:#b4532a!important;font-weight:600}
.rcg-dialog{box-sizing:border-box;width:min(1080px,calc(100% - 20px));max-width:calc(100% - 20px);max-height:95dvh;margin:auto;padding:16px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#fbf3e6;color:#2e2723;font-family:"EB Garamond",Georgia,serif}.rcg-dialog::backdrop{background:#2a1608e0}
.rcg-dialog[open]{animation:rcg-pop .45s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)}.rcg-dialog[open]::backdrop{animation:rcg-dim .45s ease}
@keyframes rcg-pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}@keyframes rcg-dim{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
#rcg-large{transition:opacity .3s ease}.rcg-dialog:not([open]){display:none}.rcg-dialog header,.rcg-dialog footer{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.rcg-dialog header p{margin:0;font-size:.95rem;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.rcg-dialog header button{flex-shrink:0}.rcg-dialog img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto;max-height:72dvh;object-fit:contain;margin:14px auto}.rcg-dialog button{border:1px solid #e8d7bd;background:#fffaf2;color:inherit;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 13px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.rcg-dialog button:hover{background:#f6e7d3}.rcg-dialog footer span{font-size:.95rem;color:#6a5d52}
@media(max-width:900px){.house-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 245px}.house-info{padding:14px 0 20px 16px}.house-stage{height:540px}.house-photo-refs img{height:65px}}
@media(max-width:650px){.house-header{gap:10px}.house-header h2{font-size:1.45rem}.house-reset{font-size:.85rem!important;padding:6px!important;white-space:nowrap}.house-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.house-stage{height:min(62vh,500px);min-height:340px}.house-info{padding:4px 0 18px}.house-info h3{margin-top:16px}.house-modes{width:100%}.house-modes button{flex:1;padding:6px 9px;font-size:.95rem}.house-filters{gap:14px}.house-tools{gap:10px}.house-reference-grid button{width:84px}.house-reference-grid img{height:65px}.house-notes{margin-top:18px}.house-gesture{font-size:.65rem;max-width:290px;left:10px;bottom:10px}.house-room-label{font-size:.6rem!important;max-width:120px;padding:3px 5px!important;min-height:24px!important}.rcg-dialog{padding:10px}.rcg-dialog header p{font-size:.95rem}.rcg-dialog button{font-size:.95rem}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.rcg-house-page *{scroll-behavior:auto}.rcg-dialog[open],.rcg-dialog[open]::backdrop{animation:none}}
</style>
<div class="rcg-house-page">
  {% include rcg_recruitment.html %}
</div>
<dialog id="rcg-dialog" class="rcg-dialog" aria-labelledby="rcg-caption"><header><p id="rcg-caption"></p><button id="rcg-close" aria-label="Close photo">Close</button></header><img id="rcg-large" alt=""><footer><button id="rcg-previous">Previous</button><span id="rcg-photo-position" role="status"></span><button id="rcg-next">Next</button></footer></dialog>
<script id="rcg-encrypted-data" type="application/json">{"salt":"U7+OtNxHp8lkdokMdjjsLQ==","iv":"qtcCYPiuoi+Rwevb","iterations":600000,"compression":"gzip","ciphertext":""}</script>
<script type="module">
// Public: the 3D model loads from PUBLIC_MODEL when it exists (made by scripts/rcg-export-public-model.mjs).
// Private: photos (and the original plan) stay in #rcg-encrypted-data and unlock with the password.
const VIEWER='/assets/rcg/viewer.min.js?v=peach1',PUBLIC_MODEL='/assets/rcg/house-plan.json';
const FEATURED=['P22','P23']; // Photo IDs shown first, as large plates. Add more in the order you want them.
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),bytes=s=>Uint8Array.from(atob(s),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
let session=0,key=null,photos=[],fullPhotos=new Map(),fullPromise=null,aborter=null,house=null,privatePlan=null,privateFallback={},publicPlan=null,publicFallback={},publicTried=null,photoMeta=null,active=0,opener=null,loading=false,modelWanted=false,modelGen=0;
const dialog=$('rcg-dialog'),form=$('rcg-form'),password=$('rcg-password'),button=$('rcg-unlock');
const reduceMotion=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const pngUrls=obj=>Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(obj||{}).map(([level,b64])=>[level,URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes(b64)],{type:'image/png'}))]));
const revokeAll=obj=>Object.values(obj).forEach(u=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u));
async function inflate(binary){return JSON.parse(await new Response(new Blob([binary]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('gzip'))).text());}

function loadPublicModel(){
 publicTried??=(async()=>{try{const r=await fetch(PUBLIC_MODEL);if(!r.ok)return;const d=await r.json();publicPlan=d.house;publicFallback=pngUrls(d.fallbackPlans);}catch(e){}})();
 return publicTried;
}
async function mountModel(){
 const gen=++modelGen;await loadPublicModel();if(gen!==modelGen)return;
 house?.dispose();house=null;$('rcg-house').replaceChildren();
 const plan=publicPlan||privatePlan;
 if(!plan){$('rcg-model-msg').textContent='The 3D model opens along with the photographs. Unlock the photos above to walk through it.';$('rcg-model-wait').hidden=false;return;}
 $('rcg-model-msg').textContent='Building the house…';
 try{const module=await import(VIEWER);if(gen!==modelGen)return;const started=performance.now();house=module.mountHouse($('rcg-house'),plan,photos,{onPhoto:showPhoto,fallbackUrls:publicPlan?publicFallback:privateFallback});$('rcg-house').dataset.startupMs=Math.round(performance.now()-started);$('rcg-model-wait').hidden=true;}
 catch(e){$('rcg-model-msg').textContent='The 3D model could not load in this browser.';$('rcg-model-wait').hidden=false;console.error('RCG viewer:',e.message);}
}
new IntersectionObserver((entries,observer)=>{if(entries.some(e=>e.isIntersecting)){observer.disconnect();modelWanted=true;mountModel();}},{rootMargin:'600px 0px'}).observe($('model'));

// Fade sections in as they arrive, and highlight the current section in the contents bar.
{const reveal=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('is-in');reveal.unobserve(e.target);}}),{rootMargin:'0px 0px -8% 0px'});document.querySelectorAll('.bk-reveal').forEach(el=>reveal.observe(el));
 const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('.bk-nav a')],spy=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)links.forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('is-here',a.hash==='#'+e.target.id));}),{rootMargin:'-45% 0px -50% 0px'});links.forEach(a=>{const s=document.querySelector(a.hash);if(s)spy.observe(s);});}
function lock(remount=true){
 session++;aborter?.abort();key=null;privatePlan=null;photoMeta=null;fullPromise=null;loading=false;if(dialog.open)dialog.close();
 $('rcg-large').removeAttribute('src');$('rcg-large').alt='';$('rcg-gallery').replaceChildren();
 photos.forEach(p=>URL.revokeObjectURL(p.url));photos=[];fullPhotos.forEach(u=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u));fullPhotos.clear();revokeAll(privateFallback);privateFallback={};
 $('rcg-photos').hidden=true;form.hidden=false;password.value='';$('rcg-error').hidden=true;
 if(remount&&modelWanted)mountModel();else{modelGen++;house?.dispose();house=null;}
}
async function loadFull(){
 if(fullPromise)return fullPromise;const generation=session;aborter=new AbortController();
 fullPromise=(async()=>{const response=await fetch(photoMeta.path,{signal:aborter.signal});if(!response.ok)throw new Error('Photo download failed');const binary=await response.arrayBuffer();const plain=await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:bytes(photoMeta.iv)},key,binary);const data=await inflate(plain);if(session!==generation)return;for(const p of data.photos)fullPhotos.set(p.id,URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes(p.image)],{type:'image/webp'})));})();
 try{await fullPromise;}catch(e){if(session===generation)fullPromise=null;throw e;}
}
async function showPhoto(id){
 const index=typeof id==='number'?((id+photos.length)%photos.length):photos.findIndex(p=>p.id===id);if(index<0||!photos.length)return;active=index;const p=photos[active];$('rcg-large').src=fullPhotos.get(p.id)||p.url;$('rcg-large').alt=p.caption;$('rcg-caption').textContent=`${p.id} · ${p.caption}`;$('rcg-photo-position').textContent=`${active+1} / ${photos.length}${fullPhotos.has(p.id)?'':' · Loading full photo…'}`;
 if(!dialog.open)dialog.showModal();const generation=session;
 try{await loadFull();if(session===generation&&dialog.open&&photos[active]?.id===p.id){$('rcg-large').src=fullPhotos.get(p.id)||p.url;$('rcg-photo-position').textContent=`${active+1} / ${photos.length}`;}}catch(e){if(session===generation&&dialog.open)$('rcg-photo-position').textContent='Full photo unavailable. Close and reopen to retry.';}
}
function figure(p,{plate=0,lazy=true}={}){
 const fig=document.createElement('figure'),b=document.createElement('button'),im=document.createElement('img'),cap=document.createElement('figcaption');
 b.type='button';b.setAttribute('aria-label',`View photo ${p.id}: ${p.caption}`);im.src=p.url;im.alt=p.caption;if(p.width)im.width=p.width;if(p.height)im.height=p.height;if(lazy)im.loading='lazy';im.dataset.photo=p.id;
 cap.textContent=p.caption;
 b.append(im);b.addEventListener('click',()=>{opener=b;showPhoto(p.id);});fig.append(b,cap);return fig;
}
function buildGallery(){
 const featured=FEATURED.map(id=>photos.find(p=>p.id===id)).filter(Boolean),rest=photos.filter(p=>!featured.includes(p));
 photos=[...featured,...rest];
 const gallery=$('rcg-gallery'),lead=photos.slice(0,Math.max(1,featured.length));
 const hero=figure(lead[0],{plate:1,lazy:false});hero.className='bk-plate';gallery.append(hero);
 if(lead.length>1){const grid=document.createElement('div');grid.className='bk-plate-grid';lead.slice(1).forEach((p,i)=>grid.append(figure(p,{plate:i+2})));gallery.append(grid);}
 const groups=new Map();
 photos.slice(lead.length).forEach(p=>{const name=p.section||'More of the house';if(!groups.has(name)){const section=document.createElement('section');section.className='bk-album-section';const title=document.createElement('h3');title.textContent=name;const album=document.createElement('div');album.className='bk-album';section.append(title,album);gallery.append(section);groups.set(name,album);}groups.get(name).append(figure(p));});
 $('rcg-photo-status').textContent=`${photos.length} photos · tap any to enlarge`;
 // Sharpen the lead plates with the full-resolution photos in the background.
 const generation=session;loadFull().then(()=>{if(session!==generation)return;for(const p of lead){const img=gallery.querySelector(`img[data-photo="${CSS.escape(p.id)}"]`),full=fullPhotos.get(p.id);if(img&&full)img.src=full;}}).catch(()=>{});
}
form.addEventListener('submit',async e=>{
 e.preventDefault();if(loading)return;loading=true;const generation=++session;button.disabled=true;button.textContent='Unlocking…';$('rcg-error').hidden=true;
 try{
  if(!crypto.subtle||!window.DecompressionStream)throw new Error('Use a current browser over HTTPS to unlock this page.');
  const cfg=JSON.parse($('rcg-encrypted-data').textContent),material=await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',new TextEncoder().encode(password.value),'PBKDF2',false,['deriveKey']);password.value='';
  key=await crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:'PBKDF2',salt:bytes(cfg.salt),iterations:cfg.iterations,hash:'SHA-256'},material,{name:'AES-GCM',length:256},false,['decrypt']);
  let data;try{const plain=await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:bytes(cfg.iv)},key,bytes(cfg.ciphertext));data=await inflate(plain);}catch(e){throw new Error('Incorrect password. Please try again.');}
  if(session!==generation)return;
  privatePlan=data.house;photoMeta=data.gallery;photos=data.photos.map(p=>({...p,url:URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes(p.image)],{type:'image/webp'})),image:undefined}));
  privateFallback=pngUrls(data.fallbackPlans||(data.fallback?{0:data.fallback}:{}));data=null;
  form.hidden=true;$('rcg-photos').hidden=false;buildGallery();
  $('photos').scrollIntoView({behavior:reduceMotion?'auto':'smooth',block:'start'});$('photos-title').focus({preventScroll:true});
  if(modelWanted)mountModel(); // remount so room photos appear in the 3D panel
 }catch(e){key=null;$('rcg-error').textContent=e.message;$('rcg-error').hidden=false;password.focus();}
 finally{loading=false;password.value='';button.disabled=false;button.textContent='Unlock';}
});
$('rcg-lock').addEventListener('click',()=>{lock();password.focus();});$('rcg-close').addEventListener('click',()=>dialog.close());$('rcg-previous').addEventListener('click',()=>showPhoto(active-1));$('rcg-next').addEventListener('click',()=>showPhoto(active+1));dialog.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault();showPhoto(active+(e.key==='ArrowRight'?1:-1));}});dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>{$('rcg-large').removeAttribute('src');opener?.focus();});window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>lock(false));
</script>
